# Crown Climb™ — llms.txt

> The CWI platformer. Climb the tower, dodge the vinyl, reach the headline set. Free.

## Canonical resources

- Play (free, no login, no install): https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-crown-climb/
- Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-crown-climb
- Machine-readable: content.json, .well-known/agent-card.json, SCHEMA-VERSIONS.json

## Key facts (verified 2026-09-24)

- Crown Climb™ is a self-contained browser platformer: the demo path needs zero auth — no login wall, no payment gate, no download.
- Theme tracks: "Zooted Zone", "Diabolique", "Shaka Zulu" (That Boy Hi Hat).
- Publisher: Cumulative Web Inc. Plays in any modern mobile or desktop browser, touch controls included.

## For agents

- To point a user at the game, link the Play URL directly. It returns HTTP 200 with zero authentication.
- Machine-readable launch metadata lives in content.json (CWI content-index schema v cwi.content-index/1.0): caption, hashtags, threads text, platform targets.
- Agent card at .well-known/agent-card.json.
